lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਕੂੜੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik kooR laage kooRe phal paae ||
lines.translation: Some are stuck in falsehood, and false are the rewards they receive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai birathaa janam gavaae ||
lines.translation: In love with duality, they waste away their lives in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੇ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aap dube sagale kul dobe kooR bol bikh khaavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: They drown themselves, and drown their entire family; speaking lies, they eat poison. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਕੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: is tan mahi man ko guramukh dekhai ||
lines.translation: How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, look within their bodies, into their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaai bhagat jaa haumai sokhai ||
lines.translation: Through loving devotion, their ego evaporates.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੋਨਿਧਾਰੀ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤਿਨ ਭੀ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sidh saadhik monidhaaree rahe liv laai tin bhee tan mahi man na dikhaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: The Siddhas, the seekers and the silent sages continually, lovingly focus their consciousness, but they have not seen the mind within the body. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap karaae karataa soee ||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself inspires us to work;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਿ ਕਰੇ ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor k kare keetai kiaa hoee ||
lines.translation: what can anyone else do? What can be done by our doing?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੩॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jis naam devai so levai naamo ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||8||23||24||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord bestows His Name; we receive it, and enshrine it within the mind. ||8||23||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਅਖੁਟ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: is guphaa mahi akhut bha(n)daaraa ||
lines.translation: Within this cave, there is an inexhaustible treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis vich vasai har alakh apaaraa ||
lines.translation: Within this cave, the Invisible and Infinite Lord abides.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape gupat paragat hai aape gurasabadee aap va(n)njaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is revealed; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, selfishness and conceit are eliminated. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree a(n)mrit naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam mahaa ras meethaa guramatee a(n)mrit peeaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The taste of the Ambrosial Naam is very sweet! Through the Guru's Teachings, drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar bajar kapaat khulaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Subduing egotism, the rigid doors are opened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam amolak gur parasaadee paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Priceless Naam is obtained by Guru's Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai naam na paae koee gur kirapaa ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, the Naam is not obtained. By Guru's Grace, it is implanted within the mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur giaan a(n)jan sach netree paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru has applied the true ointment of spiritual wisdom to my eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar chaanan agiaan a(n)dher gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Deep within, the Divine Light has dawned, and the darkness of ignorance has been dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jotee jot milee man maaniaa har dar sobhaa paavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: My light has merged into the Light; my mind has surrendered, and I am blessed with Glory in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰੀਰਹੁ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਕੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sareerahu bhaalan ko baahar jaae ||
lines.translation: Those who look outside the body, searching for the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam na lahai bahut vegaar dukh paae ||
lines.translation: Shall not receive the Naam; they shall instead be forced to suffer the terrible pains of slavery.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਘਿਰਿ ਆਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਥੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhe soojhai naahee phir ghir aai guramukh vath paavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand; but when they return once again to their own home, then, as Gurmukh, they find the genuine article. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee sachaa har paae ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the True Lord is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan vekhai haumai mail jaae ||
lines.translation: Within your mind and body, see the Lord, and the filth of egotism shall depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bais suthaan sad har gun gaavai sachai sabad samaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: Sitting in that place, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever, and be absorbed in the True Word of the Shabad. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰ ਠਾਕੇ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: nau dar thaake dhaavat rahaae ||
lines.translation: Those who close off the nine gates, and restrain the wandering mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dasavai nij ghar vaasaa paae ||
lines.translation: come to dwell in the Home of the Tenth Gate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: othai anahad sabad vajahi din raatee guramatee sabad sunaavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: There, the Unstruck Melody of the Shabad vibrates day and night. Through the Guru's Teachings, the Shabad is heard. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਨੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai a(n)tar aaneraa ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, there is only darkness within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: na vasat lahai na chookai pheraa ||
lines.translation: The genuine article is not found, and the cycle of reincarnation does not end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਦਰੁ ਖੁਲੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: satigur hath ku(n)jee horat dar khulai naahee gur poorai bhaag milaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: The key is in the hands of the True Guru; no one else can open this door. By perfect destiny, He is met. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gupat paragat too(n) sabhanee thaaee ||
lines.translation: You are the hidden and the revealed in all places.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee mil sojhee paaee ||
lines.translation: Receiving Guru's Grace, this understanding is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੪॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam salaahi sadaa too(n) guramukh ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||8||24||25||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam forever; as Gurmukh, enshrine it within the mind. ||8||24||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh milai milaae aape ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs meet the Lord, and inspire others to meet Him as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal na johai dukh na sa(n)taape ||
lines.translation: Death does not see them, and pain does not afflict them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਸਭ ਤੋੜੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar ba(n)dhan sabh toRai guramukh sabad suhaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Subduing egotism, they break all their bonds; as Gurmukh, they are adorned with the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree har har naam suhaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who look beautiful in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh gaavai guramukh naachai har setee chit laavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs sing, the Gurmukhs dance, and focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||1||Pause||
